'''Devi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] villager who was a [[Mining/Legends|miner]] until she was injured. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she worked at the power plant in the village of [[Torbel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].
